name: TreeView
summary: A hierarchy to browse and choose from: layers in a design file, folders and files, sections of a long document. Each row can open to show its children; one row is selected. Not for site navigation (Navigation) or a flat list of options (List, Select).
a11y: The ARIA tree pattern: `role="tree"` with a label, rows as `treeitem`s with their level, position and set size, `aria-expanded` on rows with children and `aria-selected` on the chosen one. One row is in the tab order (the selected one, else the first); the arrow keys move between rows. The kind icon is decorative: the label names it. Row actions are named controls inside the row (each Switch says which item it acts on); only the focused row's take Tab.

keys.action: the next or previous visible row
opens a closed row; on an open row, moves to its first child
closes an open row; on a closed row or a leaf, moves to its parent
the first or last visible row

props.name: onSelect
props.description: An item was chosen (a click, Enter or Space).

props.name: expanded
props.description: The ids of the expanded items.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: An item was expanded or collapsed: the new list.

props.name: actions
props.description: Compact controls at a row's end that act on that item (a layer's visibility and lock, as VisibilityToggles). Shown while the row is hovered or focused, and at rest with `pinActions`; their room is held so nothing moves. Only the focused row's actions are in the tab order: Tab from a row reaches its own.

props.name: actionsRoom
props.description: Where the actions sit: `held` (default) keeps their room at every row's end, so labels are always that much shorter; `overlay` takes no room at rest and lays them over the label's end on the row's own surface while shown, so labels use the full width (a design tool's narrow layers panel). Nothing moves either way.

props.name: mark
props.description: What the chosen row means: `selection` (default) the selection's fill; `current` where you are (a list of pages), a neutral fill (`c.tree-view.current-fill`).

props.name: icon
props.description: What kind of thing it is, as an icon before the label (a frame, a folder, a text layer).

props.name: meta
props.description: A short note at the end of the row: a count, a size, "Hidden".

props.name: children
props.description: Its children; an item with children can be expanded and collapsed.

props.name: muted
props.description: Drawn faded: the thing is there but switched off (a hidden layer).

props.name: pinActions
props.description: Keeps the row's actions showing at rest, because they hold a state worth seeing (a hidden or locked layer).
